summary: Backend-only testing of iteration 7 (Product.cost_price / preço de custo + preço de tabela with role-based rules). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py with 16 tests — all PASSED. Verified owner create/update persists cost_price, vendedor cannot see it (key absent from GET /api/products), vendedor POST with cost_price=99 stored as 0.0, vendedor PUT preserves owner's cost_price while still updating price, gerente sees & sets cost_price, PUT on unknown id now returns 404, legacy product docs without the cost_price key load fine (default 0.0) and can be updated, and orcamento→PDF→convert flow plus /api/stats are unaffected. Also re-ran the iteration 6 regression suite: 36 passed / 3 skipped. Company code 'gestor360' / 'Empresa123' state preserved.

minor.issue: Negative cost_price accepted (cost_price=-5 stored). No non-negative validation on price/cost_price/stock (ge=0 on Pydantic fields would fix).
No duplicate-code check on update (POST has one), so two products in the same company can end up with the same code.
Returns 200 {ok:true} for a non-existent id instead of 404 (pre-existing, consistent with clients/documents).

action_items: Optional: add ge=0 constraints to Product.price / cost_price / stock to reject negative values.
Optional: add duplicate-code validation to PUT /api/products/{id}.
Optional: return 404 from DELETE /api/products/{id} when the product does not exist.
critical_code_review_comments: _strip_cost_for_role mutates the dicts returned to the client only (motor returns fresh dicts), so it is safe; but it removes the key entirely for vendedor — frontend must handle an absent cost_price (Products.jsx already gates on isVendedor).
server.py is ~1235 lines; consider splitting routers (auth/products/documents/pdf) into modules before it grows further.
